title: Loop / Recurrent Transformer arXiv retrieval sample
scope: Not a census. Title-filtered subset of a published survey corpus plus explicitly listed supplements. Counts are records in this sample, not all arXiv papers, acceptance counts, or an estimate of a field growth rate.
dateBasis: Survey records retain the authors’ first-submission month metadata; supplements use the arXiv v1 submission date. Historical months are not all independently re-verified. Do not infer first-submission dates from arXiv ID digits.
query: Within the pinned survey core_papers.csv: title matches (loop*|recurs*|recurr*|universal) AND (transformer|language model), case-insensitive; arxiv_id required; deduplicate ID; remove explicit non-Transformer exceptions; supplement all records from loop-diffusion-papers.json plus ALBERT and recurrent-depth Huginn.

source.title: Azizi et al., Looped Language Models: A Survey and Meta-Analysis of Recurrent-Depth Transformers — author-released core_papers.csv
source.attribution: Seyedarmin Azizi, Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Massoud Pedram

excluded.2607.10110: State-space/hybrid rather than a Transformer-specific record.
excluded.2605.28919: HRM-style compact LM; Transformer depth sharing not established by the title and supplied record.
